note: Fictional sample campus. x and y are percentages (0-100) of the campus map; x runs left to right, y runs top to bottom. Distances use 1 map unit = 4 m, rounded to 5 m.

places.name: Main Gate
places.description: Main entry point to Polaris School of Technology, with a security desk and visitor registration.
places.entranceNote: Pedestrian gate on the right of the vehicle barrier; open 6 am to 10 pm.

places.name: Admissions Office
places.description: Enquiries, application support and campus tours for prospective students.
places.entranceNote: Enter through the glass door facing Gate Plaza.

places.name: Student Affairs
places.description: ID cards, fee queries, certificates and student support desk.
places.entranceNote: Ground-floor counter; take the ramp on the left of the steps.

places.name: Main Library
places.description: Reading halls, digital catalogue and silent study rooms.
places.entranceNote: Main entrance faces Central Avenue; ramp on the east side.

places.name: Lecture Hall A
places.description: Large lecture hall with 300 seats, used for first-year core classes.
places.entranceNote: Use the south entrance ramp.

places.name: Computer Lab
places.description: Programming and networking labs open for scheduled practicals.
places.entranceNote: Entrance is on the west side of the building.

places.name: Innovation Lab
places.description: Hardware prototyping, 3D printers and project workspace.
places.entranceNote: Roll-up door on the plaza side; swipe your ID to enter.

places.name: Admin Block
places.description: Director, registrar and accounts offices.
places.entranceNote: Main doors face south; reception is on the left.

places.name: Main Canteen
places.description: Meals, snacks and tea for students and staff throughout the day.
places.entranceNote: Open-air entrance next to the west walkway.

places.name: Food Court
places.description: Multiple counters with quick meals and a covered seating area.
places.entranceNote: Enter from the walkway side; seating is step-free.

places.name: Hostel Block A
places.description: Student residence with common room and laundry.
places.entranceNote: Entrance at the front; sign in at the warden desk.

places.name: Hostel Block B
places.description: Student residence with study lounge and mess hall.
places.entranceNote: Entrance at the front; sign in at the warden desk.

places.name: Sports Complex
places.description: Indoor courts, track and equipment room.
places.entranceNote: Main entrance on the west side, near the car park.

places.name: Fitness Centre
places.description: Gym with weights, cardio machines and a trainer on duty.
places.entranceNote: Entrance faces the east walkway.

places.name: Basketball Courts
places.description: Two outdoor courts, open from early morning until sunset.
places.entranceNote: Open access from the walkway; no gate.

places.name: Seminar Hall
places.description: Venue for guest talks, workshops and placement briefings.
places.entranceNote: Entrance has steps; the accessible entrance is not yet mapped.

places.name: Research Centre
places.description: Faculty research labs and postgraduate project rooms.
places.entranceNote: Entrance on the south side; visitors report at reception.

places.name: Health Centre
places.description: First aid and a visiting doctor on weekdays.
places.entranceNote: Entrance on the north side, marked with a green cross.

places.name: Cafe Orion
places.description: Small cafe for coffee and light snacks near the north lawn.
places.entranceNote: Entrance faces the lawn on the east side.

places.name: Placement Cell
places.description: Company visits, interview schedules and career guidance.
places.entranceNote: Use the side door next to the Admin Block car park.
